summary.one_liner: Galeri is a Tauri-based desktop app, described as a perpetual artwork streaming app, that is listed under Streaming in an open-source macOS apps collection.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only gives a one-line description: "A perpetual artwork streaming app." It names VS Code with Tauri and rust-analyzer as the recommended IDE setup. It gives commands to install dependencies and start a development build with the Tauri CLI. It also describes generating a signing key and producing a production build. The README does not explain what the artwork streaming features do or how the app works. The references section is empty.
notable: Built on Tauri, with a Rust backend and npm-driven tooling
Includes a signing-key step for producing signed builds
Described as a perpetual artwork streaming app
caveats: README is minimal and does not document features or usage
Target platforms are not stated in the README beyond its listing in a macOS apps collection
Build signing requires generating a private key first
